entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is facing trial in T.R. Case No.166 of 112 of 2018 for the offences under Sections 376 and 109 I.P.C. read with Section 3(2)(v) of SC & ST (P.A.) Act pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar.
He was enlarged on bail by the Court below on 09.10.2017.
However, during the trial he could not appear on 03.11.2022 which led to the issuance of NBW(A) against him.
Therefore, he has filed this petition challenging the order dated 03.11.2022 passed by the learned 2nd Additional Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar in T.R. Case No.166 of 112 of 2018.

3. The order dated 03.11.2022 passed by the learned 2nd Additional Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar in T.R. Case No.166 of 112 of 2018 is set aside with a direction to the Petitioner to surrender before the Court below and appear on each date of hearing during the trial of the offence without fail.
The Petitioner is subjected to payment of cost of Rs.1,000/- to be deposited in the Orissa High Court Advocates' Welfare Fund.
